lines: This swallowing universe in moon-sun-pot; by that indeed would be sky-goer thus, venerable Kāmika is called.
l4.sanskrit_cite: grasamānamidaṃ viśvaṃ candrārkapuṭasaṃpuṭe tenaiva syātkhagāmīti śrīmatkāmika ucyate
